subject: This is the last email you'll get from me
preview_text: I'm serious. But before I go, I need to tell you something important about your account.
body_paragraphs: I'm not going to lie—this is the twentieth email I've sent you. And if you're reading this, you're part of a very small group who actually made it this far. Most people unsubscribed by email five. But you didn't. That tells me something: you're serious about keeping the spark alive in your relationship.

Here's the thing. You're not a new user anymore. You've had SoulPlan on your phone for forty-five days. That's enough time to have planned a few dates, maybe even surprised your partner once or twice. But I bet there's a feature you haven't touched yet. Something that separates the casual users from the couples who really transform their relationship.

I'm talking about the Surprise Date Planner. It's the one feature that turns date planning from a chore into an adventure. You set the vibe, budget, and interests, then send your partner a mystery date invitation. They don't know where they're going or what they're doing until the moment you pick them up. The anticipation alone is worth it. And here's the kicker: couples who use this feature at least three times report feeling more connected than those who don't.

So here's my final ask. Open the app right now, tap the Surprise Date Planner, and plan one date this week. Don't overthink it. Just do it. Then close the app and forget about it. Your partner will thank you later. P.S. If you do this and still feel like the spark is fading, reply to this email and I'll personally send you a custom date idea. But only if you actually use the feature first.
